paragraphs: A student of R' Akiva. In [Shabbat 68b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.68b.3) and in [the Sifra, at the beginning of Metzora](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifra%2C_Metzora%2C_Section_1.3), they said: “Thus did Munbaz reason before R' Akiva, and R' Akiva said to him, 'I add to your words.'”[^1]

notes.text: Both linked passages have Munbaz reasoning before Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Akiva responding that he would add to his words. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2441&lang=en) cites both. The reasoning concerns different topics in the two sources. “Student” represents Hyman’s account.
